thread:
nate: Hey team — ran the alpha bring-up for anchorless-alpha (fp16 -> int8 symmetric) against the wiki-holdout. Quick summary: recall@1 down ~3.6%, recall@5 down ~1.1%. silhouette down 0.04, cohesion slightly higher for some tiny clusters.

maria: Oof recall@1 >3%. Did you run with KVCACHE enabled?

nate: Yes KVCACHE on, microbatch=4, seq_cap=128. quant scheme: symmetric per-tensor, no per-channel. Command: `./eval_embeddings --model anchorless-alpha:int8 --dataset wiki-holdout --k 5 --cache true --batch 4`

priya: Paste top failure examples please — especially very short queries (<8 tokens).

nate: Pasted 5 snippets below:
```
Q: "best pasta sauce"
GT: Italian marinara recipe id:12345
Nearest-int8: id:98765 (canned tomato brands)

Q: "how to reset router"
GT: id:55555
Nearest-int8: id:44444 (modem troubleshooting)
```
Not all catastrophic but indicates coarse semantic drift for short queries.

oliver: Short queries commonly lose headroom under 8-bit. Did we try per-channel quant?

nate: Not yet for this run. Per-channel will increase memory and some perf cost. I can run per-channel asymmetric next.

sam: Also consider mixed-precision: keep the embedding head fp16, rest int8. Could recover recall@1 with small perf hit.

embed-bot: CPU baseline latency: 12.8ms | int8 symmetric: 6.4ms | int8 per-channel est: 7.1ms | throughput: +1.9x

maria: Target guard is <=2% drop @1 right?

nate: Correct — we're above that. Proposal: block canary for int8 symmetric, run per-channel + mixed-precision experiments, and do a 10k-query shadow test weighted towards short queries.

priya: Agreed. Also run a cluster-cohesion breakdown: compute cluster-level recall@1 deltas and size-weighted impact; a few broken clusters could be driving the aggregate.

nate: Quick split: clusters with avg length <10 tokens lost avg 6.2% recall@1; long-query clusters improved slightly. I'll attach cluster deltas to the ticket.

oliver: If small clusters are the issue, short-term mitigation: route queries with tokens<=12 to fp16 model. Longer-term: anchor-augmented contrastive finetune focusing on short queries.

sam: Does routing support query-length policy today?

nate: Yes. Example runtime config: `routing.policies = [{\"match\": \"tokens<=12\", \"model\": \"anchorless-alpha:fp16\"}, {\"default\": \"anchorless-alpha:int8\"}]`

maria: Plan: (1) Nate: run per-channel int8 + 10k shadow (short-query heavy) (2) Priya: start contrastive finetune on short-query corpus with 50k synthetic paraphrases (3) Ops: prepare routing fallback for canary opt-in.

priya: I can kick off finetune tomorrow; using short-query corpus + synthetic augmentations. ETA 3 days for initial signal.

embed-bot: Job queued: eval-shadow/6244444444-perchannel (priority: high). ETA: ~45m.

nate: I'll post per-channel results + CSV of cluster deltas when done. For now blocking canary rollout for symmetric int8.

maria: Tagging @eng-platform to ensure routing change is opt-in for canary. :thumbsup:

oliver: I'll add a regression alert: short-query recall@1 >2% drop -> page oncall.

sam: Thanks everyone.

nate: update: per-channel run started. Will post results in this thread.
